concerns.text: Task T030 logic contradicts FR-005.5. Spec requires flagging 'Potential Leakage' if performance drops by < 10% (indicating the group feature was doing the work). T030 flags 'DESCRIPTORS INSUFFICIENT' if performance drops by > 10%. This semantic inversion violates the requirement to detect leakage vs. descriptor sufficiency correctly.

Task T018f (cleaning pipeline) lists T017a (sample count filter) as a dependency, but T017a is described as a sub-step *inside* T018f's description. This creates a circular dependency where the filter cannot run before the pipeline that contains it, violating FR-003's requirement to exclude entries with N < 30 before further processing.

Task T027d gates saving the best model on the outcome of the permutation test (T029). If the test fails (p >= 0.05), the model is never saved. This violates the Plan's 'Risks & Mitigations' (Exploratory reporting) and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility), as the trained model artifact is required to reproduce the 'Not Significant' result.

Task T055 introduces a 'streaming' fallback for large datasets. This contradicts the Spec's 'Assumptions' section which explicitly assumes the dataset fits within 7GB RAM and allows for full in-memory processing. Introducing this code path without explicit spec authorization constitutes a silent drift from the defined scope.

Task T039's description ('mean importance of the top 5 features across folds') is ambiguous regarding SC-002. SC-002 requires the CV of the *top 5 feature importance scores* (implying the stability of the ranking itself). The task text could be interpreted as calculating CV on a single scalar mean, failing to measure the stability of the *ranking* across folds as required.
